extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: OVERVIEW

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: This policy establishes that Devoted Health will reimburse SNF providers only through the date

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: coverage would appropriately end under a valid Notice of Medicare Non-Coverage (NOMNC).

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: Pursuant to CMS § 260.5.6, when a provider fails to submit the clinical documentation required by

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: the BFCC-QIO during a member appeal and coverage continues as a result, the provider may be held

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: financially liable.1 In these cases, Devoted Health will limit payment to the valid NOMNC effective

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: date. Under CMS § 260.3.6 when a NOMNC is invalid or not delivered, the provider remains financially

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: liable until a valid notice is issued and the required CMS timeframe has passed.2 Any SNF days billed

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: after the valid NOMNC effective date or CMS-defined liability cutoff (when it is determined a valid

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: NOMNC was not issued) will be denied as provider liable.

extracted_content.title: SCOPE
extracted_content.content: SCOPE

extracted_content.title: SCOPE
extracted_content.content: This policy applies to all Devoted Health plan members and all participating Skilled Nursing Facility

extracted_content.title: SCOPE
extracted_content.content: SNF providers.

extracted_content.title: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS
extracted_content.content: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS

extracted_content.title: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS
extracted_content.content: NOMNC: Notice of Medicare Non-Coverage. A standardized CMS-required notice that informs a

extracted_content.title: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS
extracted_content.content: Medicare beneficiary when coverage for a service is ending.

extracted_content.title: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS
extracted_content.content: BFCC-QIO: Beneficiary and Family-Centered Care Quality Improvement Organization. The

extracted_content.title: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS
extracted_content.content: independent review entity responsible for conducting expedited determination requests under the

extracted_content.title: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS
extracted_content.content: NOMNC process.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: POLICY

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Devoted Health will reimburse SNF services only through the effective date listed on a valid NOMNC.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: When coverage continues because the provider did not meet its obligations under the expedited

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: determination process, or when a NOMNC is found invalid or undelivered, the resulting days of

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: service are the financial responsibility of the provider. SNF days billed after the applicable NOMNC

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: effective date, or after the date coverage would have appropriately ended had a valid notice been

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: issued, will be denied as provider liable.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Member Wins the Appeal Due to Provider Failure to Submit Required Documentation

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: When a provider does not submit the BFCC-QIO with the medical records or information necessary to

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: complete an expedited review, the BFCC-QIO may render a favorable decision for the member based

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: solely on the information available.1 CMS requires providers to submit all requested medical records

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: by close of business on the day of BFCC-QIO notification.3 Failure to meet these requirements

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: prevents the BFCC-QIO from determining medical necessity.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: In such cases, Devoted Health will limit payment to the effective date on the valid NOMNC issued by

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: the facility. All SNF days beyond that date are the financial responsibility of the provider, and any

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: such days billed will be denied as provider liable.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Provider Failure to Issue a Valid NOMNC

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: CMS requires that the NOMNC be delivered at least two calendar days before coverage ends and

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: include all required elements.4 If the BFCC-QIO determines that a NOMNC is invalid or was not

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: delivered, the facility is financially liable for all days of service beyond the date coverage would have

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: appropriately ended under a valid notice.2 Devoted Health will not reimburse SNF services furnished

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: beyond the date coverage would have appropriately ended under a valid notice. When a NOMNC is

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: invalid or not delivered, the provider remains liable for continued services until a new valid notice is

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: issued and either:

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● two calendar days have passed after the beneficiary receives the valid notice, or

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● the effective date listed on the new notice occurs,

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: whichever is later.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Subsequent Medical-Necessity Appeal Outcomes

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: If a member initially wins an expedited appeal on a technical basis (including, but not limited to, a

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: facility's failure to submit required documentation to the BFCC-QIO or the issuance of an invalid

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: NOMNC), the facility is financially liable for continued services as defined under CMS rules, including

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: However, if the facility subsequently issues a valid NOMNC and the member prevails on a later

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: BFCC-QIO appeal on medical-necessity grounds, the plan will backdate coverage to include all days

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: the BFCC-QIO determines to be medically necessary. This includes days that were provider-liable

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: solely due to the earlier technical defect. Only days determined not medically necessary, or days

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: following the end of the medically necessary period, will remain provider-liable.
